grammarFocus: 一般现在时；I / you / we / they 的实义动词；时间表达与频率词入门。
title: My Busy Week
instructions: 这是模拟练习材料，不是官方雅思考试。请先听录音（或阅读文字稿），然后回答问题。所有问题都是单选题或填空题。填空题答案必须来自原文，且不超过规定字数。
transcript: A: Hi, Mei. Do you have a busy week? B: Yes, I do. I work from Monday to Friday. A: What time do you start work? B: I start at nine o'clock. A: Do you work in the evening? B: No, I don't. I usually relax at home. A: What about the weekend? B: On Saturday, I go shopping with my sister. We buy food and clothes. A: Do you cook on Sunday? B: Yes, I do. I cook dinner for my family. We eat at seven o'clock. A: That sounds nice. B: Do you have a busy week too? A: Yes, I do. I study English every day. B: Good luck!

questions.prompt: Mei 从星期几工作到星期几？
questions.explanation: Mei 说：“I work from Monday to Friday.” 所以是从星期一到星期五。
questions.evidence: I work from Monday to Friday.

questions.explanation: Mei 说：“I start at nine o'clock.” 所以是九点。
Mei 说：“No, I don't. I usually relax at home.” 所以她晚上不工作。
questions.evidence: No, I don't. I usually relax at home.

questions.prompt: Mei 星期六和谁去购物？
questions.explanation: Mei 说：“On Saturday, I go shopping with my sister.” 所以是和她的姐妹。
questions.evidence: On Saturday, I go shopping with my sister.

questions.explanation: Mei 说：“Yes, I do. I cook dinner for my family.” 所以她星期天做饭。
questions.evidence: Yes, I do. I cook dinner for my family.

questions.prompt: Mei 家几点吃晚饭？用数字填空：____ o'clock。
questions.explanation: Mei 说：“We eat at seven o'clock.” 所以是七点。

questions.prompt: 另一个人（A）每天做什么？填空：I study ____ every day.
questions.explanation: A 说：“I study English every day.” 所以是学英语。
Mei 说：“We buy food and clothes.” 所以是食物和衣服。

grammar.title: 一般现在时：I / you / we / they 的实义动词
grammar.explanation: 一般现在时表示经常发生的动作或习惯。当主语是 I、you、we、they 时，动词用原形。例如：I work. You study. We eat. They play. 否定形式用 don't + 动词原形，例如：I don't work. 疑问形式用 Do + 主语 + 动词原形？例如：Do you work?
grammar.example: I work from Monday to Friday.

questions.explanation: 主语是 I，动词用原形 work。
questions.evidence: I work from Monday to Friday.

questions.explanation: 主语是 they，否定用 don't + 动词原形。
questions.evidence: No, I don't. I usually relax at home.

questions.explanation: 主语是 you，疑问句用 Do 开头。
questions.evidence: Do you have a busy week?

questions.explanation: 主语是 we，动词用原形 eat。
